valid.message: owner_type "subaccount" requires a lowercase canonical UUID (identity.users.id / identity.sub_accounts.id), but got "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc:z". An account is never opened for an owner whose identifier space is undeclared: a bigint member id where a user UUID belongs would open a SECOND conformant account for the same human, and every invariant would still report clean (§4.2, ADR 2026-08-02).
